Updates
	

Updates to MedCalc-Bench Verified will be made on this page going forward. 
Here is the github link for our repository: https://github.com/nikhilk7153/MedCalc-Bench-Verified

You should specify which version (i.e. "MedCalc-Bench Verified v1.0.2". ect.) when you used when using this dataset. 
You can find the version and the date each release was updated on Github:… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nsk7153/MedCalc-Bench-Verified.
evaluation_method: exact_match / numeric_error (e.g., absolute or relative error) and accuracy for discrete items
general_score_metric: exact_match (for discrete answers) and numeric error metrics (MAE/MAPE) for continuous outputs
reputation: An updated, curated variant of MedCalc-Bench with growing use among medical-NLP and evaluation communities; adoption remains modest.
